pkgmetadata.longdescription: MSCCL++ is a GPU-driven communication stack for scalable AI applications. It provides a high-performance inter-GPU communication library that supports NVIDIA CUDA and AMD ROCm, with optional InfiniBand support. It implements the HybridFlow communication model used by verl and similar ML training frameworks.

use.flag: Enable InfiniBand RDMA support via rdma-core
Build and run MPI-based unit tests
